basis: 2026-10-30: blaize chose unreal 5.8 for metahuman (realistic likeness with a face rig), control rig full-body ik, and fab environment packs; unity stays the gameplay spec the way the rawah browser game specs the godot port

engines.unreal: 5.8 / c++ climbing sim ported from unity / control rig + full body ik planned

passed: both prototypes load the same authored hold and physics data
initial four-contact hangs remain stable on all three routes
reachable holds attach and distant holds do not
first reaches stay attached on all three routes
release and fall restore the starting stance
scripted vertical, overhang, and traverse sequences all reach the final hold
unity mac standalone launches without a startup exception
limitations: the climber is a constrained rigid torso and procedural proxy limbs, not a full active ragdoll or anatomical ik
the first-person camera is an inspection prototype, not polished body-aware animation
touch, console, pc build, character animation, audio, and gym progression were not tested
desktop frame pacing and tablet thermals have not been measured in a medium-poly gym
no real-climber validation of grip and movement rules has happened yet
next: build unreal/ once 5.8 finishes installing, pass Rougarou.ClimbSim, then mesh to metahuman on the blaize scan driven by the sim through control rig

previous_decision.basis: blaize chose unity after viewing both playable windows and described it as much cleaner; no claim that its physics benchmarked faster
